options.name: api_path
options.description: The path of the service which a record is to be created, updated or deleted from. Mutually exclusive with C(resource). Require one of C(resource) or C(api_path).

options.name: columns
options.description: List of fields/columns to return in the response.

options.name: display_value
options.description: Return field display values C(true), actual values C(false), or both C(all). Default value is set to C(false).

options.name: exclude_reference_link
options.description: C(true) to exclude Table API links for reference fields. The default is C(false).

options.name: no_count
options.description: Do not execute a select count(*) on table. Default is set to C(false).

options.name: normalize_column_names
options.description: If true, the column names in O(columns) will be normalized to lowercase. This is a legacy behavior. If your column names are not lowercase, set this to false to preserve the original case in the response.

options.name: query_category
options.description: Name of the query category to use for queries.

options.name: query_no_domain
options.description: If set to C(true) to access data across domains if authorized. Default is set to C(false).

options.name: resource
options.description: The name of the table in which a record is to be created, updated or deleted from. Mutually exclusive with C(api_path). Require one of C(resource) or C(api_path).

options.name: sys_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the record to retrieve.

options.name: sysparm_query
options.description: An encoded query string used to filter the results. List of all possible operators and a guide on how to map them to form a query may be found at U(https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/tokyo-platform-user-interface/page/use/common-ui-elements/reference/r_OpAvailableFiltersQueries.html). and U(https://developer.servicenow.com/dev.do#!/reference/api/tokyo/rest/c_TableAPI) under 'sysparm_query'.
